interpretations.LIMIT_NONE: 'no obvious common failure' is fixed as every method having D_core >= 0.70
interpretations.coordination_type_first_divergence: operational definition fixed before any result: a first divergence is of coordination type when (a) the diverging action itself destroys a satisfied goal atom, or (b) the episode contains a repeated (state, action) pair, or (c) the episode destroys a satisfied goal atom at any step (covers wrong goal order that undoes completed work)
interpretations.pooling: one seed per method; the unit of evidence is the case, with the caveat that a deterministic policy on one seed is not an independent-seed estimate

limitation_mainline.LIMIT_COORDINATION: a minimal new algorithm for goal preservation / ordering is allowed
limitation_mainline.LIMIT_MIXED: failure sources differ or evidence is insufficient; do not widen the matrix
limitation_mainline.LIMIT_NONE: no common failure; no new algorithm indicated by this card
limitation_mainline.LIMIT_TRAINING: decide first whether to switch all methods to planner imitation; do not interpret OOD

mainline.REP_CANDIDATE_CONDITIONING_NEEDED: develop a unified candidate-conditioned relational computation; do not rush to choose between B2 and QMARK
mainline.REP_DIRECT_READOUT_SUFFICIENT: do not package QMARK as a new algorithm; paper follows unified explanation, diagnostic protocol and conditional comparison
mainline.REP_MIXED: do not widen the matrix; locate one minimal decidable question from the existing logs
mainline.REP_QUERY_ADVANTAGE: query propagation as the main implementation candidate; tighten the difference to the ASNet-style readout
mainline.REP_SUCCESSOR_ADVANTAGE: explicit successor as the algorithm mainline; study its extra role in multi-step composition
